6. (calculus, of a univariate differentiable function f(x)) A function giving the change in the linear approximation of f at a point x over a small interval \Delta x or \operatorname{d}\!x, the function being called the differential of f and denoted \operatorname{d}\!f(x,\Delta x), \operatorname{d}\!f(x), or simply \operatorname{d}\!f.
7. (multivariable calculus) The Jacobian matrix of a function of several variables.
8. (differential geometry, of a smooth map \phi between smooth manifolds) The pushforward or total derivative of \phi: a linear map from the tangent space at a point x in \phi's domain to the tangent space at \phi(x) which is, in a technical sense, the best linear approximation of \phi at x; denoted \operatorname{d}\!\phi_x.
9. (mathematics) Any of several generalizations of the concept(s) above: e.g. the Kähler differential in the setting of schemes, the quadratic differential in the theory of Riemann surfaces, etc.
